First reasoned review: all three supplied samples are BENIGN.

ApexMSP2 Loader 1.7.7 (17fa928139fc):
The service worker exchanges Apex Hub session/license credentials, fetches an
AES-GCM-protected licensed game script, and injects it into MovieStarPlanet 2.
The early auth hook saves game JWTs in the same page's sessionStorage; no token
export is present in the supplied hook. Messages select operations; they do not
supply the compiled code. Downloaded licensed payload bytes are not supplied.
The hostile messaging/compilation rule required co-occurrence, not data flow.
Move the three neutral extension composites to WebExtension injection; describe
co-occurrence. Record aliased request-header setter replacement as notable.
Browser settings URLs are not profile directories or external native handlers.

Credential-reporting stub (6827db770f9f):
Seven lines, one uncalled and unexported function. Its unused credential URI
and link-local host constants do not read environment variables or issue a
metadata request. The function's payload is undefined; no top-level network
call occurs. Without collection, invocation, install context, or evidence of
unauthorized transfer, the hostile CI/ECS install claims are unsupported.
Record request(method POST) and an IAM SecretAccessKey record as neutral
capabilities. Replace install claims with suspicious, accurately described
co-occurrence composites requiring actual credential acquisition plus a JSON
request body. CI and cloud results have their respective secret-source homes.
Keep a real ECS collector positive control. Proc/Docker references plus a POST
also do not establish a hostile install beacon; relocate those neutral facts.

Zhihu Answer Capture 2.0.0 (f300eddda075):
Captures paginated Zhihu answer content into local IndexedDB and an offline
viewer. Optional AI requests use user-configured endpoints/API keys and obtain
host permissions. The flagged literal is a fixed defensive guard telling the
model to reject untrusted instructions; provider requests use that guard.
Preserve the negation in the matched span and exclude only that quotation;
a separate live override in the same file remains suspicious.
Move neutral link selection, origin comparisons and GitHub ZIP links out of
supply-chain objectives. Website /answers/ URLs are not evaluation corpora;
a Gemini name near a tool token is not an agent; a local variable named lex
is not evidence of the Lex build tool. Retire the uninformative lex atom.

Additional placement/reference corrections:
Device identity object fields -> serialize/schema-object.
Password-shaped pwd/passwd object keys -> serialize/schema-credential.
Discord service-name references -> os/application/target.
Discord invitation URLs -> communications/http/services/discord.
Consumers use the canonical relocated traits. Metadata profiles no longer
consume bare service/tool vocabulary as an artifact property.
